explicit_nonclaims: No claim that the Big Bang was a bomb-like explosion in pre-existing space.
No claim that one explosion directly created life as we know it.
No claim that one nuclear detonation at one oil field inevitably ends humanity.
No claim that an oil reservoir is a giant underground lake or cavern.
No claim that all underground hydrocarbons ignite simultaneously.
No claim that oil guarantees a secondary explosion larger than the nuclear event.
No claim that hydrogen-1 neutron capture directly produces tritium.
No claim that oil necessarily produces globally significant tritiated water.
No claim that black rain or a standardized 'nuclear coke' is a guaranteed product.
No operational guidance for selecting, damaging or amplifying effects on energy infrastructure.
No claim that direct neutron irradiation of crude oil is a proven clean industrial refining route.
No claim that hydrogen from hydrocarbons is carbon-free without carbon accounting and management.
No claim that nuclear process heat is automatically safe, sustainable, economical or morally authorized.
No claim that peaceful benefits redeem or justify nuclear weapon use.

peaceful process-heat concepts with safety and lifecycle gates
